title: LLM Cost Estimate
summary: Estimates an LLM batch's tokens and cost from your own dated price table before it runs, so a missing max_tokens or wrong model doesn't cause a surprise bill.
description: Pre-run cost panel that estimates input/output tokens and cost from your dated price table, shows the worst case without max_tokens, catches context-window overflows, runs far bigger than the last and premium models on bulk jobs, and shows Batch API savings.
catches: Request bigger than the model's context window
Run many times larger than the last one
Premium model picked for a bulk job, with a switch
Batch API discount on bulk jobs
limits: Token counts are estimates unless you pass inputTokens; real tokenizers differ by model
Prices come only from your table; it doesn't fetch provider pricing
Doesn't enforce a budget; your API key limits or server must
a11y: Model select and max-tokens input have visible labels
Inputs get aria-invalid when a finding applies
Focus moves to the first finding's fix after a change
server: Set spend limits and max_tokens on the server or API key; the estimate doesn't cap anything.
stops: Surprise bill from an LLM batch
